note: ForeverRank's own best-in-slot rankings: every slot ranked per class, spec, faction and level by The Forge's weights (plan/gear.js score and presets) over our item database. Sources are from our own data: codex/loot.json, QuestBank's quest catalogue and the database's recipe items. Built by tools/build_bis.mjs; nobody's hand-picked list is copied. Rows: [item id, score (the whole number The Forge's picker shows), indexes into src, side (a or h) when only one faction can get it, 1 for a two-hander]; a main-hand slot's charge is what each two-hander's score already lost for the off hand it replaces. src: [kind, text, side]. pair: the legal two-slot pick for rings and trinkets; set: the best weapon setup. held: per level, the quest rewards from quests open at that level that stay out because their required level is not stored and The Forge's estimate (item level - 5) is higher.
